anomalies.observed: T5 (AON6407 P-MOSFET) has its source (pin 2) connected to /+24V_F (input after fuse) and drain (pin 3) connected to +24V (output rail).
anomalies.expected: For reverse polarity protection with a P-MOSFET, the source should be on the output rail (+24V) and the drain on the input (/+24V_F), so the body diode is reverse-biased when input polarity is reversed.

evidence.quote: README states the PCB includes 'reverse polarity protection, TVS diodes, proper isolation'

anomalies.impact: Under reverse polarity, the P-MOSFET body diode conducts, defeating the reverse polarity protection and potentially damaging the board.

anomalies.observed: R9 (10k) is connected from the main pump MOSFET gate net /NET0044 to +3V3, acting as a pull-up. The ESP32 control signal IO10 connects through R15 (100Ω) to the same gate.
anomalies.expected: R9 should be a pull-down to GND (as R19 is for the ATO valve gate), so the ESP32 signal IO10 can drive the gate high/low and control the main pump.

evidence.quote: T2 — IRLR2905 (DPAK N-MOSFET) — Main circulation-pump low-side switch. Netlist: drives PUMP_MAIN net to the 24 V main pump load; gate driven through R1 (100 Ω) from the ESP32 pin

anomalies.impact: The main pump cannot be turned off by IO10; with R9 pulling up, driving IO10 low leaves the gate at ~3.27V, above the IRLR2905 threshold, so the pump stays on unless T4 overrides. This defeats firmware control of the main pump.

anomalies.observed: ADM3260 VSEL pins (U4.13, U11.13) are connected to resistor dividers (R8/R54 and R14/R31) between VDD_ISO and GNDISO, rather than being tied to a logic level.
anomalies.expected: Per ADM3260 datasheet, VSEL should be tied to GNDISO for 3.3V or to V_ISO for 5V. The spec requires isolated +5V, so VSEL should be tied to V_ISO.

evidence.quote: Each isolated EZO channel (U3 for pH, U4 for EC) derives its own isolated +5V (/V_pH, /V_EC) internally from the ADM3260's isoPower feature

anomalies.impact: The isolated supply voltage may be incorrect (likely 3.3V instead of 5V) or undefined, causing the EZO pH/EC circuits to operate at the wrong voltage or fail to start.

parsed.summary: The design files contain multiple anomalies: the reverse-polarity P-MOSFET T5 has source/drain swapped, defeating reverse polarity protection; the main pump gate pull-up R9 prevents IO10 from controlling the pump; and the ADM3260 VSEL pins use resistor dividers instead of the required logic-level select.
